verdict.rationale: The only credential evidence is that tokens can be created and expired in the dashboard. Nothing shows those tokens can be scoped by namespace, operation (read vs. write), or other least-privilege boundaries. The permissions doc describes document-level access filtering that the application applies at query time. That is a developer building block, not scoped API credentials, so neither item earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
